source: Curated major global events; dates are UTC calendar dates.

events.name: Wright brothers' first powered flight
events.description: The Wright Flyer made the first controlled, sustained powered flight at Kitty Hawk.

events.name: Penicillin discovered
events.description: Alexander Fleming observed that Penicillium mould inhibited bacterial growth.

events.name: Trinity test
events.description: The first detonation of a nuclear weapon took place at Alamogordo, New Mexico.

events.name: Sputnik 1 launched
events.description: The Soviet Union placed the first artificial satellite into Earth orbit.

events.name: First human spaceflight
events.description: Yuri Gagarin completed one orbit of Earth aboard Vostok 1.

events.name: Apollo 11 launch
events.description: Apollo 11 launched from Kennedy Space Center on the first crewed Moon-landing mission.

events.name: Hubble Space Telescope launched
events.description: The Hubble Space Telescope was deployed into low Earth orbit aboard Space Shuttle Discovery.

events.name: Human Genome Project completed
events.description: The international consortium announced that the human genome had been sequenced to near-completion.

events.name: Higgs boson discovery announced
events.description: CERN announced the observation of a new particle consistent with the Higgs boson.

events.name: Gravitational waves announced
events.description: LIGO reported the first direct detection of gravitational waves from merging black holes.

events.name: United Nations founded
events.description: The UN Charter entered into force, formally establishing the United Nations.

events.name: India independence
events.description: India became independent from British rule and a new sovereign state was established.

events.name: People's Republic of China founded
events.description: Mao Zedong proclaimed the People's Republic of China in Beijing.

events.name: March on Washington
events.description: More than 200,000 people gathered in Washington, D.C.; Martin Luther King Jr. delivered 'I Have a Dream'.

events.name: Berlin Wall opened
events.description: East Germany opened its border crossings, leading to the fall of the Berlin Wall.

events.name: Soviet Union dissolved
events.description: The Supreme Soviet formally dissolved the Soviet Union, creating fifteen independent republics.

events.name: September 11 attacks
events.description: Coordinated terrorist attacks struck the World Trade Center and the Pentagon.

events.name: Barack Obama elected
events.description: Barack Obama was elected the first African American president of the United States.

events.name: Brexit referendum
events.description: The United Kingdom voted to leave the European Union.

events.name: US presidential election
events.description: Joe Biden defeated incumbent Donald Trump in the US presidential election.

events.name: Wall Street Crash
events.description: The New York Stock Exchange suffered the crash that preceded the Great Depression.

events.name: Nixon shock
events.description: President Nixon ended the dollar's convertibility into gold, ending the Bretton Woods system.

events.name: Black Monday
events.description: Global stock markets crashed on a single day, with the Dow Jones falling more than 20%.

events.name: Asian financial crisis
events.description: Currency and market turmoil spread across East and Southeast Asia.

events.name: Dot-com peak
events.description: The Nasdaq Composite reached its dot-com bubble peak before a multi-year decline.

events.name: Lehman Brothers collapse
events.description: Lehman Brothers filed for bankruptcy, precipitating the global financial crisis.

events.name: COVID-19 market crash
events.description: Global equity markets began a rapid sell-off as the COVID-19 pandemic spread.

events.name: 2022 rate shock
events.description: Global markets began repricing sharply as central banks signaled rapid rate increases.

events.name: Yen carry unwind
events.description: A sharp unwind of yen-funded positions triggered a global risk-off move.
